visualReview.notes: Inspected all responsive boundaries and both themes. The cover image owns the flexible top region without a scrim; the copy band is distinct and flush to the viewport bottom; 768px forms two balanced top-aligned columns while 767px and narrower preserve heading, description, and CTA order. Exactly two actions remain visible, wrap safely at 320px, and no clipping, overflow, duplicate trees, or excluded navigation/form/logo artifacts appear. Reduced-focus and JavaScript-disabled captures retained their expected markers.
